summary_md:
# Intrum bommade förväntningarna – Sivers med svag rapport

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-28  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon for 28 Aug 2026 led with Intrum's Q2 report. Headline numbers were roughly in line, but servicing growth and costs came in weaker, and the CEO was interviewed on the results. The panel was sharply critical of Sivers' hype-driven valuation and debated Boliden's Nexa Resources deal, which adds 8% to EPS but lowers the valuation multiple. Mood on software/SaaS stocks after Salesforce's report was upbeat, and Europe/Sweden macro surprises are turning positive.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 INTRUM — Intrum | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Servicing -2% organic, segments 7-8% below expectations, cost base too high; guest expects negative share reaction and a confidence question.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lars Söderfjell: headline in line but details weak. Servicing, the value driver, isn't growing because of Greece/Spain, and a flat servicing-revenue target for FY2026 now looks challenging. Positives: 2.3bn cash flow, pro forma leverage 4.3x heading to 3.0x by 2028, and investment volumes rising in H2. The turnaround depends on cost cuts and servicing margins moving from 23% towards 30%.

#### Sell Triggers

- servicing organic growth stays negative
- cost program fails to reach 10-11bn cost target
- servicing margins do not improve towards 30%
- deleveraging stalls

> *"Det tror jag tyvärr kommer att ta... Aktien kommer att reagera negativt på idag."*

---

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Losses up 70%, no real revenue until 2027; valued ~12bn vs ~1bn implied 2030 sales; panel skeptical and guest stays away from hope stocks.

#### Reasoning

Reporter Nordenstam says the valuation needs sales hopes that even the company's own 25-30% growth target can't justify (~1bn SEK in 2030 vs 12bn market cap). The opportunity pipeline is a vague metric. Guest Söderfjell avoids hope-driven companies and would rather miss the first gains than risk a 99% loss. Reporter expects the stock to fall.

#### Sell Triggers

- first meaningful customer invoicing/revenue ramp
- concrete large orders converting from pipeline

> *"Den ska förmodligen ner. Den indikeras ner i orderboken."*

---

### 🟡 BOL — Boliden | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Nexa deal +8% EPS but blended multiple ~15% lower and higher LatAm risk; guest says it's a 'wet blanket' on valuation; Handelsbanken cut to hold.

#### Reasoning

Guest calls Nexa a good company bought at a fair price, with sensible share-financed funding. But the jurisdiction risk changes Boliden's profile, and he would prefer capex on organic projects (Laver, Älgträsk, Nautanen, copper). Host Martin is more positive on the aggressive growth move. Handelsbanken downgraded to hold from buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- squeeze-out of Nexa minority becomes costly or delayed
- zinc price weakens
- LatAm jurisdiction issues
- new Brazilian owner sells down

> *"Det lägger lite grann en blöt filt på den här vad det gäller värdering."*

---

### 🟢 KINV-B — Kinnevik | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Host suggests Kinnevik as a tech re-rating play; guest agrees he believes in the re-rating.

#### Reasoning

After Salesforce's strong AI report, beaten-down Swedish software stocks and Kinnevik rallied. Host: 'Even Kinnevik, if you believe in a re-rating of tech.' Guest: 'Yes, I do. I agree.' A light, conversational endorsement.

#### Sell Triggers

- tech/SaaS re-rating reverses
- AI disruption fears return

> *"Till och med Kinnevik om man nu tror på en omvärdering av tech. Ja, det gör jag. Jag håller med."*

---

### 🟠 ANOD-B — Addnode | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Down 30% in six months; beaten-down SaaS may be swinging back after Salesforce, but the guest says the jury is still out.

#### Reasoning

Guest thinks AI agents will cap SaaS pricing power long term, but SaaS isn't dead since customers still pay for support, QA and documentation. After a big fall the pendulum may be swinging back. Host flagged Addnode as a beaten-down example.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI agents erode license pricing
- SaaS rebound fades

> *"Jag tittar på Addnode som är ner. 30 procent på sex månader."*

---

### 🟠 EQT — EQT | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Guest says EQT should have gained more on the Salesforce effect after being hit by SaaS worries.

#### Reasoning

Lars Söderfjell would add EQT to the stocks that should benefit from easing SaaS fears. It was hit hard by SaaS exposure concerns but reacted only modestly, which suggests catch-up potential.

#### Sell Triggers

- SaaS worries return

> *"Jag skulle egentligen lägga till en till aktie som borde Det har gått mer på EQT."*

---

### 🟠 VOLV-B — Volvo | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Cited analyst: SEB's new Volvo analyst raises estimates considerably with a positive note.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion only (SEB). The hosts note the stock is at the top of OMXS30 on the estimate increase.

#### Sell Triggers

- truck demand weakens

> *"SEB har ett analytikerbyte på Volvo och de tar upp estimaten ganska mycket idag."*
